user.title: Connect to Sharp Kitchen
user.description: Enter the email and password for your Sharp Kitchen (na-kitchen) account -- the same one used in the Sharp Kitchen phone app.

error.invalid_auth: Login failed. Check your email and password. If they're correct, Sharp's login may require a login method this integration doesn't support yet (see the README).
error.cannot_connect: Logged in, but could not reach the Sharp Kitchen device service to verify your account. Please try again.

abort.already_configured: This Sharp Kitchen account is already set up.

start_cook.name: Start Cook
start_cook.description: Start a manual cook on a Sharp Kitchen device.

device_id.name: Device ID
device_id.description: The numeric device ID from Sharp's backend.

mode.name: Mode
mode.description: Cook mode name ("microwave" is confirmed working).

temperature.name: Temperature
temperature.description: Target temperature for modes that use one.
